description: Searches chunk bodies and headings for a phrase.

prefer.description: Boost this type in the ranking.

name: search
title: Search the vault

description: Reads a chunk, or a note: its body (the text before its first ## heading) and its table of contents. Notes carry a compact links counter (out/in/broken); the links tool has the details.

backlinks.description: Append the chunk ids that link here.

name: read
title: Read a note or section

description: Shows outgoing and incoming references of a note or chunk — [[wiki]] and [text](path.md) links, resolved with status ok/ambiguous/broken.

depth.description: Defaults to 1; 2 adds each directly connected note's own depth-1 view.

name: links
title: Show links

description: Creates a new note. The path is normalized first — the response contains path_normalized_from when that changed it.

content.description: Markdown body, starting with an H1.

create_dirs.description: Create a missing project directory under projects/.

ends.description: ISO timestamp, only for type: event.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

starts.description: ISO timestamp, only for type: event.

name: create
title: Create a note

description: Appends content to an existing note.

heading.description: Section name, one non-empty line; without it, appends at end of file.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

name: append
title: Append to a note

description: Replaces the body of exactly one chunk.

content.description: New body, without headings of its own.

if_match.description: Optional: the section's hash from read. The edit is refused if the id no longer holds that content.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

name: replace_section
title: Replace a section

description: Replaces the entire body of a note; frontmatter is preserved. Requires confirm: true only past the shrink threshold. The result lists the links from other notes into its sections that the rewrite broke.

confirm.description: Only required once the rewrite crosses Policy's shrink threshold (removes more than half of the note's headings, or more than 20); optional otherwise.

content.description: New body, starting with an H1.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

name: rewrite_note
title: Rewrite a note

description: Removes a chunk including its heading.

if_match.description: Optional: the section's hash from read. The edit is refused if the id no longer holds that content.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

name: delete_section
title: Delete a section

description: Sets type/starts/ends in the frontmatter of an existing note, keeping every other key, and writes the block if the note has none; the body is untouched.

ends.description: ISO timestamp, only for type: event.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

starts.description: ISO timestamp, only for type: event.

name: update_frontmatter
title: Update frontmatter

description: Permanently deletes a note. Destructive — requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Must be true, otherwise the call is rejected.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

name: delete_note
title: Delete a note

description: Moves or renames a note; both paths are normalized. Destructive — requires confirm: true. With update_links: true, the links that point at the note are rewritten in the same commit.

confirm.description: Must be true, otherwise the call is rejected.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

update_links.description: Rewrites the wiki links and Markdown links in every note that links to the moved one, keeping each link's text and #fragment.

name: move_note
title: Move a note

description: Reports notes that are not UTF-8, duplicate headings, sentence-like headings, broken links, overlong notes and stale decision notes.
name: lint
title: Check the vault

description: Returns the current time plus active and nearby events.
name: current
title: Current time and events

description: Fetches from the remote, puts vigil's unpushed commits on top of what it holds, and reparses the vault.
name: reload
title: Reload from the remote

description: Reports whether the index is loaded and the writer answers, commits ahead of and behind the remote (as of the last fetch), the last push's result and time, and, as stale, when and why the vault last failed to update from the remote.
name: status
title: Server status

description: Lists available skills with their description, without bodies.
name: skill_list
title: List skills

description: Reads the full content of a skill.
name: skill_read
title: Read a skill

description: Creates or replaces a skill; only on explicit instruction. Replacing an existing skill is destructive — requires confirm: true. vigil-vault-conventions is protected and cannot be written.

confirm.description: Must be true to replace a skill that exists, otherwise the call is rejected; a new skill needs none.

request_id.description: Optional, unique per write. A retry with the same request_id returns the first result (already_applied: true) instead of writing again.

title: Write a skill
